morphology.formula: permainan + -nya → permainannya；词基内部：per- + main + -an → permainan
morphology.pattern_note: root_word 保留输入提供的直接词基 permainan，最终词根为 main。-nya 是后附着代词，可表示第三人称领属或回指已知事物。词基末尾 n 与 -nya 的 ny 相接，写作 nn 而非删去一个 n。输入 Jawi 仅对应 permainan，完整形式应补写 -nya：ڤرماءيننڽ。

senses.zh_definition: 他／她的玩具或游戏用品；前文所指的玩具或供玩耍之物。
senses.en_definition: His or her toy or plaything; the previously mentioned plaything.
senses.ms_definition: Barang untuk bermain yang dimiliki olehnya atau yang telah disebut.
senses.nuances: -nya 不标示性别，也不自动表示复数。要明确指实体玩具，马来西亚日常常说 mainannya 或 alat permainannya。基础义项见 [DBP：permainan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=10456&keyword=permainan)。

collocations.en: put away his or her playthings

senses.zh_definition: 他／她所玩的游戏、所参加的运动，或其玩法、比赛表现；也可指前述游戏的玩法。
senses.en_definition: His or her game, play, or sporting performance; the play or mechanics of a previously mentioned game.
senses.ms_definition: Kegiatan bermain yang disertainya, cara dia bermain, atau cara sesuatu permainan dijalankan.
senses.nuances: permainannya menarik 可说游戏本身有趣，也可说某人的打法有看点；必须结合前文判断。

collocations.en: his or her style of play
the quality of his or her play

senses.zh_definition: 他／她不当真的行为、恶作剧或把戏。
senses.en_definition: His or her fooling around, prank, or deceptive game.
senses.ms_definition: Perbuatan main-main atau helah yang dilakukannya.
senses.nuances: 常含不满或指责；具体是无伤大雅的玩笑还是欺骗行为，由上下文决定。

collocations.en: be taken in by his or her tricks
put a stop to his or her fooling around

senses.zh_definition: 他／她的舞台表演或演出。
senses.en_definition: His or her theatrical performance or stage presentation.
senses.ms_definition: Lakonan atau persembahan pentas yang dilakukannya.
senses.nuances: 属于较旧或文学性的表达；当代常用 persembahannya 或 lakonannya。下列为典型语境组合，不代表现代高频搭配。见 [DBP：permainan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=10456&keyword=permainan)。

collocations.en: his or her performance on stage

collocations.zh: 他／她在那出戏中的表演
collocations.en: his or her performance in that play

senses.zh_definition: 被他／她戏弄、嘲弄或玩弄的人或事物。
senses.en_definition: A person or thing treated as his or her plaything or object of ridicule.
senses.ms_definition: Orang atau perkara yang dijadikannya bahan ejekan atau diperlakukan sesuka hati.
senses.nuances: 与第三义的区别是：这里指被玩弄的对象，而非玩弄行为。见 [DBP：permainan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=10456&keyword=permainan)。

collocations.zh: 只是供他／她玩弄的对象

senses.zh_definition: 被他当作消遣或满足情欲对象的女子；带物化意味的旧口语用法。
senses.en_definition: A woman treated as his sexual plaything; a dated, objectifying usage.
senses.ms_definition: Perempuan yang diperlakukannya sebagai teman berseronok semata-mata.
senses.nuances: 这是词典记录的旧口语义，带贬损和物化色彩。下列组合仅帮助辨识旧文本。见 [DBP：permainan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=10456&keyword=permainan)。

collocations.en: a woman he treats as a sexual plaything
be treated as his sexual plaything

senses.zh_definition: 他／她的吊坠或小饰物；印度尼西亚地域用法。
senses.en_definition: His or her pendant or small ornament, in Indonesian usage.
senses.ms_definition: Barang hiasan kecil miliknya, seperti loket pada kalung, dalam penggunaan Indonesia.
senses.nuances: DBP 标为印度尼西亚用法，非马来西亚日常核心义；在马来西亚通常说 loketnya 或 hiasannya。下列组合用于辨识语境。见 [DBP：permainan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=10456&keyword=permainan)。

collocations.en: the pendant on his or her necklace

dual_scenarios.context: 体育新闻 / 教练赛后评价
dual_scenarios.ms: Jurulatih memuji pemain muda itu kerana mutu permainannya semakin meningkat sepanjang kejohanan.
dual_scenarios.zh: 教练表扬了那名年轻球员，因为他在整个锦标赛期间的比赛水平不断提高。
dual_scenarios.en: The coach praised the young player because the quality of his play kept improving throughout the tournament.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 朋友讨论球员表现
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Permainannya dah makin kemas sekarang, kan?
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Permainannya sudah semakin kemas sekarang, bukan?
dual_scenarios.zh: 他现在打得越来越稳了，对吧？
dual_scenarios.en: His play is getting much more polished now, isn't it?
spoken_features: kan 用于寻求认同，对应 bukan
-nya 不标示性别；本例前文所谈球员为男性

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Permainannya dah makin kemas sekarang, kan?
messages.ms_standard: Permainannya sudah semakin kemas sekarang, bukan?
messages.zh: 他现在打得越来越稳了，对吧？
messages.en: His play is getting much more polished now, isn't it?

messages.speaker: Hafiz (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Haah, dia dah kurang buat silap. Aku nak tengok dia main lagi.
messages.ms_standard: Ya, dia sudah kurang melakukan kesilapan. Saya hendak melihatnya bermain lagi.
messages.zh: 对啊，他失误少多了。我还想再看他比赛。
messages.en: Yeah, he's making fewer mistakes. I'd like to watch him play again.

etymology.historical_story: The word shows two layers of Malay grammar. Main supplies the idea of play; per-...-an forms permainan, naming a game, playing, or related activity. The attached -nya then identifies whose play is meant or refers back to an established game. Its wider dictionary senses extend play toward performance, unserious conduct, and being treated as a plaything. See [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=10456&keyword=permainan).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: main＝玩；per-...-an 把“玩”装进名词盒，成为 permainan；再接 -nya，就成为“他／她的玩法、游戏或表现”。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 评价运动员时，permainannya kemas 或 permainannya baik 自然得体；说某人的行为只是 permainan，可能暗示其不认真或有意操弄。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 体育、儿童游戏和舞台语境须靠上下文区分。把人称为 permainan 会产生物化或羞辱意味；描述关系纠纷时，宜直接说明具体行为。
